_comment_cooldown: Mirrors minimumReleaseAge in pnpm-workspace.yaml. A compromised release is usually yanked well inside a week, so waiting is the cheapest defence we have against a hijacked publish.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions are pinned to commit SHAs; Renovate must keep the SHA and the version comment in step.
TypeScript minors are breaking in practice, so they are never grouped with anything else. The 6.0 line is pinned until typescript-eslint supports TS 7 (typescript-eslint#10940).
Vite is pinned exact (ADR-005): a bundler bump changes output, so it lands on its own with a bundle-budget check.
Lint and formatting tooling can move together — a failure there is loud and harmless.
Security fixes bypass the weekly schedule but never the cooldown.
